packageRules.description: Deny-list compromised axios versions (supply chain attack 2026-03-31)

Org-owned resources are ref-pinned (@main), never SHA-pinned. A repo that opts into helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests MUST also carry this rule in its own packageRules (last-match-wins) — see the SHA-pinning-policy ADR in netresearch/.github.
